title: helichrysum obcordatum subsp. majus
intro: Helichrysum obcordatum subsp. majus, commonly known as the mountain everlast, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the daisy family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum obcordatum subsp. majus include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
